assertion: SVG CSS transforms use fill, stroke and view reference boxes, group bounds and origins; CSS overrides the transform attribute, including none. Individual transforms precede transform and use positioning.

browser.reason: Chrome and Firefox agree on geometry and CSS overriding the transform attribute. WebKit retains translate(-50) when CSS says transform:none, contrary to the cascade rule. Reviewed Valle differences are only the antialiased edges of the two 30-degree rectangles (266 pixels, maximum 26 channels on Metal).
